items.title: Lennar Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Housing Weakness, Revenues Lag
items.summary: LEN stock falls as Q3 earnings and revenues miss estimates and decline year over year. Weaker deliveries, pricing and margins reflect continued housing demand pressures.

items.title: Lennar Q3 earnings fall as homebuilder cuts annual delivery target
items.summary: Lennar Corp (NYSE:LEN) reported a 52% drop in third-quarter net earnings and lowered its annual delivery target.
